items.title: Preston Jackson Interview, 1973-09-07
items.q: Dave Peyton, and he later on with Dave Peyton was at the Regal Theater.

ctx.x: Yeah. I'm trying to think, because.

Yeah, Eddie Atkinson is a very good musician. He played mostly in theaters, you know. He played in the Grand Theater for years. Dave Peyton, and he later on with Dave Peyton was at the Regal Theater. He played, I'd taken his place at the Regal Theater. That was before the Vitaphone, you know. We had to play the music for the pictures, fanfare, and then the stage presentation, you know.
Well, back to Roy Palmer and your fish fries. What instrument did he play at the fish fries? You said everything like that.
